tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.helm.passive: HUD: charge, target, the Mind's warnings. Hides your face
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.helm.set: Full set: hover, palm blast, shoulder launcher
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.core.passive: Holds the charge and the Mind
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.arms.passive: Punch boost (bare-fisted); Sneak + right-click to lift heavy corpses
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.arms.slot: Worn in the legs slot: the frame that drives the arms
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.mind_asleep: The Mind sleeps until the Core is worn
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.salvage: Built into Rig pieces at a Rig Forge (3 points)
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.salvage.lore: Pulled from a dead suit in a dead city
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.scrap: Built into Rig pieces at a Rig Forge (1 point)
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.scrap.lore: Scorched. Someone wore this looking for a way off Earth
rig.jaymospowers.hud.title: RIG
message.jaymospowers.rig.incomplete: The Rig's actives need the whole set: Helm, Core, Arms and Thrusters
message.jaymospowers.rig.lift: The Rig's arms take the weight
message.jaymospowers.rig.no_mind: No Core, no Mind: the suit is silent
message.jaymospowers.rig_forge.selected: Forge: %s. Needs %s salvage points (you have %s), %s %s and %s %s. Right-click to build, Sneak + right-click for the next piece
rig.jaymospowers.augment.wind: Rig augment (Wind): the thrusters' gusts last longer; hover drains less
rig.jaymospowers.augment.gravity: Rig augment (Gravity): a heavier punch boost
rig.jaymospowers.augment.chrono: Rig augment (Chrono): the Core recharges faster
rig.jaymospowers.augment.web: Rig augment (Web): palm blasts web the target, slowing it
rig.jaymospowers.augment.arsenal: Rig augment (Arsenal): the launcher fires one more missile
rig.jaymospowers.augment.resonance: Rig augment (Resonance): palm blasts knock back harder
rig.jaymospowers.augment.darktide: Rig augment (Darktide): the Mind feels hunters behind you from farther off
rig.jaymospowers.augment.smoke: Rig augment (Smoke): palm blasts blind for a moment
rig.jaymospowers.augment.xenoform: Rig augment (Xenoform): palm blasts reach farther
rig.jaymospowers.augment.zfighter: Rig augment (Z Fighter): the punch boost knocks back harder
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.0: Log, day 41: "The portal was supposed to be the way out. It's just more Earth, burning."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.1: Log, last entry: "Charge at 2%. If anyone finds this suit: the stars aren't this way."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.2: Log: "Three of us came through. The others turned back. I should have."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.3: Log: "The End has no sky to fly into. Only void. Thrusters won't hold."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.4: Scratched into the chest plate: "Off-world or nothing."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.5: Log: "Mind's gone quiet. I keep talking to it anyway."
rig.jaymospowers.dead.lore.0: The visor is cracked. Behind it, nothing has moved in a lifetime.
rig.jaymospowers.dead.lore.1: A Mind's last words loop on a dying speaker: "...hold position... hold..."
rig.jaymospowers.dead.lore.2: Its Core is dark. The machines that killed it are still out there.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.void: Nothing below us. Please, pull up!
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.low_health: You're badly hurt. Let's fall back.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.low_charge: Charge is low. Find me power.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.empty: I'm sorry, there's no charge left.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.struck: Lightning! Fully charged, and still with you.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.report: Charge at %s%%. Ready when you are.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.wake: Systems online. Try not to break me.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.explosion: That's going to explode. Just a thought.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.lava: Lava. Below. In case you wondered.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.empty: No charge. Wishful thinking won't fire it.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.wake: Mind online. Everyone dies. Not today.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.void: The void. No one comes back.
